title: Hugging Face / NVIDIA living analysis
thesis: As capability distribution converges with execution infrastructure, governance must move from evaluating models as objects to governing consequence-bearing transitions as they occur.

NVIDIA_ACQUISITION_ANNOUNCEMENT.claim_scope: NVIDIA announced/agreed to acquire Hugging Face; source does not establish transaction close or execution authority.

STEGVERSE_FIXED_PAPER.claim_scope: Fixed thesis and architectural interpretation; not a longitudinal observation.

SV_DN1_TECHNICAL_SURFACE.claim_scope: Defines exact-byte public-source capture, identity/revision extraction, governed adjacent-hop receipt construction, and reconstruction behavior. Source presence alone is not live runtime evidence.

HF_QWEN_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT.claim_scope: Selected external artifact target for SV-DN-1; no current revision is asserted in this T0 analytical record because no retained same-checkpoint payload is available here.

checkpoints.authenticity_note: T0 contains only retained source statements and explicitly bounded Site/SV-DN-1 evidence. It does not fabricate a later Hugging Face observation or infer runtime execution from source, CI, deployment, or publication reachability.

metrics.label: Capability distribution ↔ execution proximity
metrics.effect_on_analysis: The announced organizational convergence places a major capability-distribution substrate closer to an execution-infrastructure vendor, increasing the importance of preserving an explicit consequence-bearing execution boundary.
metrics.interpretation_rule: If distribution and execution infrastructure become organizationally or technically closer while admissibility remains a distinct unresolved function, the core boundary thesis is supported.

metrics.label: Evidence of standing execution authority transferred with capability
metrics.effect_on_analysis: The acquisition announcement is evidence of ownership/integration intent, not evidence that Hugging Face artifacts carry standing authority to execute consequential transitions. Absence of such evidence neither proves nor disproves future authority coupling.
metrics.interpretation_rule: Do not treat ownership, provenance, compatibility, or distribution as execution authority unless explicit current-state authority evidence is observed.

metrics.label: External artifact identity/revision observability
metrics.effect_on_analysis: The inability to truthfully state the current model revision without a retained same-checkpoint observation demonstrates why artifact identity must remain an evidence question rather than a narrative assumption.
metrics.interpretation_rule: A missing current artifact observation remains a gap; the system must not infer exact identity/revision from the existence of source code, endpoint names, or earlier execution descriptions.

metrics.label: Reconstructability of external-capability ingress
metrics.effect_on_analysis: The technical contract separates source bytes, semantic mapping, adjacent-hop receipts, and authority effect. That separation is the kind of evidence structure required if capability distribution becomes more tightly coupled to execution infrastructure.
metrics.interpretation_rule: Presence of a reconstructability contract supports the architectural thesis only as a design/evidence capability; it must not be upgraded into a claim of current runtime execution without authentic execution evidence.

metrics.label: Observed change since acquisition baseline
metrics.effect_on_analysis: The current record cannot yet say whether NVIDIA/Hugging Face integration is increasing or decreasing the practical separation between distribution, evaluation, admissibility, and execution. A second authentic checkpoint is required.
metrics.interpretation_rule: Longitudinal claims require at least two authentic checkpoints. T0 alone cannot establish direction of change.

assessment.summary: The acquisition announcement supports the central StegVerse thesis that distribution/execution boundaries deserve explicit governance as capability infrastructure converges. T0 does not show that standing execution authority has transferred, and it does not yet measure post-announcement change. The most important present finding is methodological: exact artifact state, authority, and integration change must remain observable evidence questions, and missing observations must stay visible as gaps.
assessment.strongest_supporting_observation: The capability-distribution and execution-infrastructure layers are moving closer organizationally, while the retained evidence does not collapse provenance or ownership into execution authority.
assessment.strongest_challenge: No authentic longitudinal checkpoint yet exists, so the analysis cannot claim that the acquisition has actually reduced or increased execution-boundary separation in practice.
assessment.next_evidence_needed: An authentic T1 observation retaining current Hugging Face artifact/platform state and NVIDIA/Hugging Face integration signals under the same metric definitions.
